title: Task descriptor (resolver input)
description: The resolver's only input: one task, described declaratively. referenced_entities are namespace-qualified names of exported kinds (namespace.kind) and are matched against declared routing hints in step 1 of the resolution algorithm. max_tokens is the single economic parameter of v0.1. freshness_requirement is an ISO-8601 duration compared against each resolved model's declared sync_contract freshness. task_ref is optional: the resolver mints one deterministically when it is absent, and the emitted context pack and Twin Composition Snapshot carry it either way.

task_ref.description: Stable reference for this task. Optional: minted by the resolver when absent; carried into the context pack and the snapshot.

purpose.description: Declared purpose of the task. Matched against routing hints and carried into the pack for purpose limitation and audit.

requester_identity.description: The identity the context is resolved for. Carried into the pack; the projection builder is the enforcement point for any entitlement mapping, deny by default when a declared mapping cannot be evaluated.

items.description: Namespace-qualified name of an exported kind, for example plmm.product.

max_tokens.description: Token budget for the whole context pack. The single economic parameter in v0.1.

freshness_requirement.description: Optional maximum acceptable staleness as an ISO-8601 duration, for example PT24H. A source older than this yields a staleness flag in the pack's coverage statement.
